title: Clair3 IN — per-sample small-variant calling manifest
description: One object per Clair3 invocation. Describes the inputs Clair3 needs to produce a per-sample VCF. See Modules/03_clair3.

sample_id.description: Sample identifier from the project sample sheet. Becomes the VCF sample column header.

bam_path.description: Absolute path to the input BAM. Read-group SM tag should match sample_id.

bam_index_path.description: Absolute path to the BAM .bai (or .csi) index.

reference_fasta_path.description: Absolute path to the reference FASTA used during alignment (fClaHyb_Gar_LG.fa for this project).

reference_fasta_index_path.description: Absolute path to the reference .fai index.

model_path.description: Absolute path to the Clair3 model directory matching the sequencing platform (e.g. ont_guppy5, ilmn).

platform.description: Sequencing platform — selects pileup vs full-alignment defaults.

region_bed_path.description: Optional callable-region BED. When provided, Clair3 is restricted to these intervals. Typically the cohort callable mask from Module 01.

min_coverage.description: Minimum read depth at a candidate site.

min_mq.description: Minimum mapping quality for reads contributing to the pileup.

snp_min_af.description: Candidate-site minor allele fraction threshold for SNPs.

indel_min_af.description: Candidate-site minor allele fraction threshold for indels.

haploid_sex_chrom_contigs.description: Contigs to genotype as haploid for this sample (e.g. ChrY/W in homogametic vs heterogametic samples). Empty if the project treats the genome as diploid throughout.

out_vcf_path.description: Absolute path where the bgzipped per-sample VCF will be written (e.g. ${BASE}/results/clair3/<sample_id>.vcf.gz).
